en.title: Models
en.keyPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the stored key
en.noModels: No models returned. Check the provider settings.
en.dragHint: Drag to reorder, or use Alt + arrow keys
en.unsavedHint: You have unsaved changes. Save them or discard them before closing.
en.deleteHint: This deletion will be saved immediately. Continue?
en.busy: A save is in progress. Please retry shortly.
en.requestError: Could not read or save model settings. Please retry.
en.unavailable: This provider cannot be edited here.
en.conflict: These settings changed elsewhere. Close this editor and reopen it.
en.invalidProvider: Provider ID cannot be empty or contain spaces, dots or slashes.
en.invalidKey: API keys cannot contain whitespace or control characters.
en.providerRequired: Enter an API URL and choose a protocol.
en.invalidModel: Model IDs must be nonempty and unique within the provider.
en.invalidCapacity: Enter a positive integer, or a value such as 256K or 1M.
en.invalidInput: Keep at least one input type enabled.
en.invalidEfforts: Keep a reasoning level and provide nonempty API values.
